metadata.scope: EGFR-mutant lung cancer resistance simulator seed data
notes: IC50 values are simulator seed values in nM, chosen to encode qualitative sensitivity/resistance patterns until raw public exports are supplied.
Use data/raw public exports to replace or refine these values for analysis-grade work.
Do not use this dataset for clinical decision making.

growth_rate values for clones without matched models are legacy placeholders; the calibration pipeline inherits the parent clone's measured growth and applies the assumed fitness_cost once (see growth_inheritance).
source_families: Cell Model Passports / GDSC for cell model drug response
cBioPortal / MSK-IMPACT for tumor alteration frequencies

resistance_evidence.relationship: acquired resistance to first-generation EGFR inhibitors

resistance_evidence.evidence_source: CIViC and cBioPortal alteration evidence families

resistance_evidence.relationship: bypass resistance mechanism after EGFR inhibitor exposure
resistance_evidence.evidence_source: CIViC and cBioPortal alteration evidence families

model_exclusions.reason: homozygous PTEN loss confers intrinsic EGFR-TKI resistance despite the EGFR exon 19 deletion; not representative of an EGFR-inhibitor-sensitive clone
model_exclusions.evidence: Sos ML et al., Cancer Res 2009;69(8):3256-61, PMID 19351834 (H1650 erlotinib resistance via PTEN loss / AKT); consistent with GDSC2: gefitinib IC50 16.5 uM, AUC 0.93; erlotinib IC50 3.2 uM

drug_response_assay.name: GDSC2 fitted dose-response: IC50 is the concentration giving 50% relative viability after 72 h of exposure
drug_response_assay.source: Yang W et al. NAR 2013 (GDSC); Iorio F et al. Cell 2016; Vis DJ et al. Pharmacogenomics 2016 (IC50 fitting); GDSC_Fitted_Data_Description.pdf release 8.5
drug_response_assay.derivation: The simulator models drug effect as added death. For a clone at C = IC50 the Hill effect is 0.5, so relative viability after T days is exp(-k_max * 0.5 * T). Setting this to 0.5 at T = 3 days gives k_max = ln(2) / 1.5 = 0.462 per day, independent of growth rate. This assumes a purely cytotoxic effect; cytostatic effects are not modelled.

hill_coefficient.source: curated simulator seed; GDSC sigmoid slopes are not exported per curve
